name: io.github.canaca/agentproof
title: AgentProof
description: Concept / early access, not a live service. Static MCP-style descriptor for AgentProof. A live server would let an AI agent record that a person authorized an agent-initiated purchase, for a Shopify or Stripe dispute evidence packet. No MCP transport is listening. Do not connect, and do not send secrets.

hypotheticalTools.name: create_authorization_proof
hypotheticalTools.description: Hypothetical. Would record that a person authorized a specific agent-initiated purchase and return a reference for a later dispute packet. Not callable on this static host.

purchase.description: Amount, currency, and the plain-language summary the person confirmed.

human_authorization.description: When the person confirmed, and the words they were shown. Not a card number.
